title: Dwell in Us - Advent 1
author: Francesca LaRosa
snippet: To you, I lift up my soul, O my God. In you, I have trusted; let me not be put to shame. Nor let my enemies exult over me; and let none who hope in you be put to shame.

title: Responsorial Psalm - Advent 1
author: Psalm 80: 2-3, 15-16, 18-19
snippet: Lord, make us turn to you; let us see your face and we shall be saved.

title: Gospel Acclamation
author: Psalm 85:8
snippet: Show us, Lord, your love; and grant us your salvation.

title: The King Shall Come
author: Trevor Thomson
snippet: The King shall come when morning dawns and light triumphant breaks; When beauty gilds the eastern hills and life to joy awakes. Not, as of old, a little child, to bear, and fight, and die; But crowned with glory like the sun that lights the morning sky.

title: Sanctuary
author: John W. Thompson, Randy Scruggs
snippet: Lord, prepare me to be a sanctuary; pure and holy; tried and true. With thanksgiving; I'll be a living Sanctuary for You.

title: A Voice Cries Out
author: Michael Joncas
snippet: Console my people, the ones dear to me; speak to the heart of Jerusalem: the time of your mourning is ended now, the Lord of life will come.

title: Come, Lord! Maranatha
author: Ricky Manalo CSP
snippet: Now is the time to wake from sleep; salvation is close at hand. Moving from night into day, lift up your voices and pray:

title: We Are Ready
author: Jim Ngô xSUNO
snippet: Christ the Lord is near! (We are ready to greet the King) Christ the Lord is near! (We are ready to greet the King) Christ the Lord is near! (We are ready to greet the King) Hallelujah! Hallelujah! We are ready to greet the King!

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Lord, have mercy. Christ have mercy. Lord have mercy

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Glory to God! Glory to God in the highest, and on earth, peace to people of goodwill.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Holy, holy, holy Lord God of hosts. Heaven and earth are full of your glory. Hosanna in the highest. Blessed is he who comes in the moment of the Lord. Hosanna in the highest.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: When we eat this bread and drink this cup, we proclaim your death, O Lord, until you come again.

author: Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
Mass of St. Mary Magdalene - Sarah Hart
snippet: Lamb of God, You take away the sins of the world; have mercy, have mercy on us.
